item.description:
• Dictation no longer fails silently. Some apps - Electron ones especially - accept an insert and then quietly drop it, and Amanu used to report success anyway. It now reads the field back and only says "Inserted" when your words are actually there; when it can prove nothing arrived it tries the other insertion path and, failing that, says so. The check only ever reports a failure it can prove, so a working insert is never turned into a false error.
  • Your words now go to the app you were in when you pressed the hotkey, not whichever app happens to be in front when the text is ready. Transcription and Refine take time, and switching apps or a notification stealing focus used to redirect the sentence with no warning. If focus moved, Amanu switches back first; if it cannot get back - the app quit, or will not come forward - it inserts nowhere rather than typing into the wrong app, and names the app it could not reach.
  • New setting, Settings > Insertion > "When the app changes": "Go back" (the new default) or "Follow focus" for the previous behavior, which never switches apps for you.
  • A failed insert no longer costs you your clipboard. The dictated text is left there for a Cmd-V only when your clipboard was empty; if you had copied something, you get it back and the transcript is recovered from the error's Copy button or History. The HUD message now says "Copied instead." only when the text really is on the clipboard.
  • First-run setup no longer throws a macOS permission dialog at you on the Accessibility step. The step opens the right System Settings pane and tells you which row to switch on, so the only buttons to press are Amanu's own.
  • The setup window steps out of the way for the microphone prompt instead of covering it, so the request is visible the moment it appears.
